reduce_metrics_across_devices: reduce metrics across pmapped devices using pnanmean pmin pmax or psum reduction functions
flatten_nested_metrics_dict: flatten a nested metrics dictionary to a single level with underscore-separated keys
compute_pnanmean: compute the mean of non-nan elements across pmapped devices using jax lax psum
compute_pnantake_reduction: apply a custom reduction like pmin or pmax over non-nan elements across devices
compute_pnanreduce: get the count and reduced value of non-nan elements across pmapped devices
